import cocotb
from cocotb.triggers import Timer


class Bench:
    def __init__(self, dut):
        self.dut = dut

    async def tick(self, count=1):
        for _ in range(count):
            self.dut.clk.value = 0
            await Timer(5, unit="ns")
            self.dut.clk.value = 1
            await Timer(5, unit="ns")

    async def reset(self):
        d = self.dut
        d.clk.value = 0
        d.rst_n.value = 0
        d.wb_rst_i.value = 0
        d.wb_adr_i.value = 0
        d.wb_dat_i.value = 0
        d.wb_we_i.value = 0
        d.wb_stb_i.value = 0
        d.wb_cyc_i.value = 0
        d.stretch_en.value = 0
        d.ext_scl_low.value = 0
        d.ext_sda_low.value = 0
        await self.tick(4)
        d.rst_n.value = 1
        await self.tick(4)

    async def write(self, addr, data):
        d = self.dut
        d.wb_adr_i.value = addr
        d.wb_dat_i.value = data
        d.wb_we_i.value = 1
        d.wb_stb_i.value = 1
        d.wb_cyc_i.value = 1
        await self.tick()
        assert int(d.wb_ack_o.value) == 1
        await self.tick()
        assert int(d.wb_ack_o.value) == 0
        d.wb_we_i.value = 0
        d.wb_stb_i.value = 0
        d.wb_cyc_i.value = 0
        await self.tick()

    async def read(self, addr):
        self.dut.wb_adr_i.value = addr
        await self.tick()
        return int(self.dut.wb_dat_o.value)

    async def setup_master(self, prescale=9, control=0x80):
        await self.write(0, prescale & 255)
        await self.write(1, (prescale >> 8) & 255)
        await self.write(2, control)

    async def clear_interrupt(self):
        await self.write(4, 1)
        await self.tick(3)
        status = await self.read(4)
        assert (status & 1) == 0, "IACK did not clear IF"

    async def wait_done(self, limit=8000):
        self.dut.wb_adr_i.value = 4
        for _ in range(limit):
            await self.tick()
            status = int(self.dut.wb_dat_o.value)
            assert (status & 0x1c) == 0, "Reserved status bits are nonzero"
            if status & 1:
                await self.tick(3)
                status = int(self.dut.wb_dat_o.value)
                assert (status & 2) == 0, "TIP still set after completion"
                return status
        assert False, "I2C command did not complete"

    async def command(self, cmd, tx=None, ack=None):
        await self.clear_interrupt()
        if tx is not None:
            await self.write(3, tx)
        await self.write(4, cmd)
        status = await self.wait_done()
        assert (status & 0x20) == 0, "Unexpected arbitration loss"
        if ack is not None:
            assert ((status >> 7) & 1) == ack, "Incorrect received ACK"
        return status

    async def write_bytes(self, pointer, values):
        await self.command(0x90, 0xa0, 0)
        await self.command(0x10, pointer, 0)
        for index, value in enumerate(values):
            cmd = 0x50 if index == len(values) - 1 else 0x10
            await self.command(cmd, value, 0)

    async def read_bytes(self, pointer, count):
        await self.command(0x90, 0xa0, 0)
        await self.command(0x10, pointer, 0)
        await self.command(0x90, 0xa1, 0)
        result = []
        for index in range(count):
            cmd = 0x68 if index == count - 1 else 0x20
            await self.command(cmd)
            result.append(await self.read(3))
        return result

    await b.tick()

    dut.wb_adr_i.value = 0

    await b.tick()
    assert int(dut.wb_ack_o.value) == 1
    await b.tick()
    assert int(dut.wb_ack_o.value) == 0
    dut.wb_we_i.value = 0
    await b.tick()
    assert int(dut.wb_ack_o.value) == 1
    await b.tick()
    assert int(dut.wb_ack_o.value) == 0
    dut.wb_cyc_i.value = 0
    dut.wb_stb_i.value = 0
    await b.tick()
    assert await b.read(0) == 0x87
    assert await b.read(1) == 0x69

    # Read data updates even with no Wishbone request.
    dut.wb_adr_i.value = 2
    await b.tick()
    assert int(dut.wb_dat_o.value) == 0xbf
    dut.wb_adr_i.value = 5
    await b.tick()
    assert int(dut.wb_dat_o.value) == 0xa6

    dut.wb_rst_i.value = 1
    await b.tick()
    dut.wb_rst_i.value = 0
    await b.tick(3)
    assert await b.read(0) == 0xff
    assert await b.read(1) == 0xff
    assert await b.read(2) == 0
    assert await b.read(3) == 0
    assert await b.read(4) == 0
    assert await b.read(5) == 0
    assert await b.read(6) == 0

async def addressing_interrupt_and_bus_state(dut):
    b = Bench(dut)
    await b.reset()
    await b.setup_master(control=0x80)

    # A START and STOP generated by an external bus participant are visible
    # in BUSY, even when the master has no command in progress.
    dut.ext_sda_low.value = 1
    await b.tick(40)
    assert int(dut.sda.value) == 0
    assert int(dut.scl.value) == 1
    assert (await b.read(4)) & 0x40
    dut.ext_sda_low.value = 0
    await b.tick(40)
    assert (await b.read(4)) & 0x40 == 0

    dut.ext_scl_low.value = 1
    await b.tick(20)
    assert int(dut.scl.value) == 0
    dut.ext_sda_low.value = 1
    await b.tick(20)
    assert (await b.read(4)) & 0x40 == 0
    dut.ext_scl_low.value = 0
    await b.tick(20)
    dut.ext_sda_low.value = 0
    await b.tick(30)
    assert (await b.read(4)) & 0x40 == 0

    # Only address 0x50 is acknowledged.
    for address_byte in (0x00, 0x9e, 0xa2, 0xfe):
        status = await b.command(0xd0, address_byte, 1)
        assert status & 1
        await b.tick(20)
        assert (await b.read(4)) & 0x40 == 0
    assert int(dut.wb_inta_o.value) == 0

    # IF is latched independently of IEN; interrupt output follows IF and IEN.
    await b.write(2, 0xc0)
    await b.tick(3)
    assert int(dut.wb_inta_o.value) == 1
    await b.write(2, 0x80)
    await b.tick(3)
    assert int(dut.wb_inta_o.value) == 0
    assert (await b.read(4)) & 1
    await b.write(2, 0xc0)
    await b.tick(3)
    assert int(dut.wb_inta_o.value) == 1
    await b.clear_interrupt()
    await b.tick(3)
    assert int(dut.wb_inta_o.value) == 0

    status = await b.command(0x90, 0xa0, 0)
    assert status & 0x40
    await b.tick(3)
    assert int(dut.wb_inta_o.value) == 1
    await b.command(0x50, 0x03, 0)
    await b.tick(20)
    assert (await b.read(4)) & 0x40 == 0
    assert await b.read(6) & 0xf0 == 0


@cocotb.test()
async def stretching_and_arbitration(dut):
    b = Bench(dut)
    await b.reset()
    await b.setup_master(prescale=9, control=0xc0)

    # Exercise the target's 24-clock stretching across consecutive bytes.
    dut.stretch_en.value = 1
    await b.write_bytes(3, [0xa5, 0x5a, 0x3c, 0xc3])
    assert await b.read_bytes(3, 4) == [0xa5, 0x5a, 0x3c, 0xc3]
    dut.stretch_en.value = 0
    await b.tick(40)

    await b.command(0x90, 0xa0, 0)
    await b.clear_interrupt()
    await b.write(3, 0x02)
    # Hold SCL low before the next byte. The transfer must remain in progress
    # and complete after the external participant releases the line.
    dut.ext_scl_low.value = 1
    await b.write(4, 0x10)
    await b.tick(200)
    status = await b.read(4)
    assert status & 2
    assert (status & 1) == 0
    assert int(dut.scl.value) == 0
    dut.ext_scl_low.value = 0
    status = await b.wait_done()
    assert (status & 0xa0) == 0

    # The bus is active and SCL is low. Force SDA low while transmitting a
    # one; the master must report arbitration loss and release its outputs.
    await b.clear_interrupt()
    dut.ext_sda_low.value = 1
    await b.write(3, 0xff)
    await b.write(4, 0x10)
    status = await b.wait_done()
    assert status & 0x20
    assert status & 1
    await b.tick(20)
    assert int(dut.scl.value) == 1
    assert int(dut.sda.value) == 0
    assert int(dut.wb_inta_o.value) == 1

    await b.clear_interrupt()
    assert (await b.read(4)) & 0x20
    dut.ext_sda_low.value = 0
    await b.tick(40)
    assert int(dut.sda.value) == 1

    # A new START clears sticky AL and allows a normal transaction.
    status = await b.command(0xd0, 0xa0, 0)
    assert (status & 0x20) == 0
    await b.tick(20)
    assert (await b.read(4)) & 0x40 == 0

            self.prev_sda = sda

        d.ext_sda_low.value = 0

        d.rst_n.value = 1
        await self.tick(4)

        d.wb_stb_i.value = 1

        await self.tick()

        d.wb_we_i.value = 0
        d.wb_cyc_i.value = 0
        d.wb_stb_i.value = 0

        self.dut.wb_adr_i.value = addr
        await self.tick()
        return int(self.dut.wb_dat_o.value)

    return int(dut.wb_dat_o.value)


async def configure(dut, prescale=4, control=0xC0):
    await wb_write(dut, 0, prescale & 0xFF)
    await wb_write(dut, 1, (prescale >> 8) & 0xFF)
    await wb_write(dut, 2, control)

async def wait_complete(dut, limit=4000):
    dut.wb_adr_i.value = 4
    dut.wb_we_i.value = 0
    dut.wb_cyc_i.value = 0
    dut.wb_stb_i.value = 0
    for _ in range(limit):

        status = int(dut.wb_dat_o.value)

            return status
    assert False, "Command did not complete"

    await wb_write(dut, 4, bits)
    status = await wait_complete(dut)
    assert (status & 0x20) == 0, "Unexpected arbitration loss"
    assert (status & 0x02) == 0, "TIP remained set at completion"
    if expected_ack is not None:

    await tick(dut, 3)

    old_sda = int(dut.sda.value)
    while True:

    await tick(dut)

async def wait_complete(dut, limit=3000):

        status = await read_reg(dut, 4)

        if status & 1:

    assert False, "I2C command did not complete"


async def command(dut, cmd):
    await clear_interrupt(dut)
    await write_reg(dut, 4, cmd)
    return await wait_complete(dut)


async def send_byte(dut, value, start_bit=False, stop_bit=False, ack=0):
    await write_reg(dut, 3, value)
    cmd = 0x10
    if start_bit:
        cmd |= 0x80
    if stop_bit:
        cmd |= 0x40
    status = await command(dut, cmd)
    assert status & 0x20 == 0, "Unexpected arbitration loss"
    assert ((status >> 7) & 1) == ack, "Wrong received ACK"
    assert status & 2 == 0, "TIP remained set after completion"
    return status


async def receive_byte(dut, nack=False, stop_bit=False):
    cmd = 0x20
    if nack:
        cmd |= 0x08
    if stop_bit:
        cmd |= 0x40
    status = await command(dut, cmd)
    assert status & 0x20 == 0, "Unexpected arbitration loss"
    assert status & 2 == 0, "TIP remained set after completion"
    return await read_reg(dut, 3)

from cocotb.triggers import Timer


class Bench:
    def init(self, dut):
        self.dut = dut
        self.tracing = False
        self.events = []
        self.prev_scl = 1
        self.prev_sda = 1

    async def tick(self, count=1):
        for unused in range(count):
            self.dut.clk.value = 1
            await Timer(5, unit="ns")
            if self.tracing:
                scl = int(self.dut.scl.value)
                sda = int(self.dut.sda.value)
                if self.prev_scl and scl and self.prev_sda and not sda:
                    self.events.append(("start", 0))
                if self.prev_scl and scl and not self.prev_sda and sda:
                    self.events.append(("stop", 0))
                if not self.prev_scl and scl:
                    self.events.append(("bit", sda))
                self.prev_scl = scl
                self.prev_sda = sda
            self.dut.clk.value = 0
            await Timer(5, unit="ns")

    async def reset(self):
        d = self.dut
        d.clk.value = 0
        d.rst_n.value = 0
        d.wb_rst_i.value = 0
        d.wb_adr_i.value = 0
        d.wb_dat_i.value = 0
        d.wb_we_i.value = 0
        d.wb_stb_i.value = 0
        d.wb_cyc_i.value = 0
        d.stretch_en.value = 0
        d.ext_scl_low.value = 0
        d.ext_sda_low.value = 0
        await self.tick(4)
        d.rst_n.value = 1
        await self.tick(8)

    async def write(self, address, data):
        d = self.dut
        d.wb_adr_i.value = address
        d.wb_dat_i.value = data
        d.wb_we_i.value = 1
        d.wb_stb_i.value = 1
        d.wb_cyc_i.value = 1
        await self.tick()
        assert int(d.wb_ack_o.value) == 1
        await self.tick()
        assert int(d.wb_ack_o.value) == 0
        d.wb_stb_i.value = 0
        d.wb_cyc_i.value = 0
        d.wb_we_i.value = 0
        await self.tick()

    async def read(self, address):
        d = self.dut
        d.wb_adr_i.value = address
        d.wb_we_i.value = 0
        d.wb_stb_i.value = 1
        d.wb_cyc_i.value = 1
        await self.tick()
        assert int(d.wb_ack_o.value) == 1
        result = int(d.wb_dat_o.value)
        d.wb_stb_i.value = 0
        d.wb_cyc_i.value = 0
        await self.tick()
        assert int(d.wb_ack_o.value) == 0
        return result

    async def configure(self, prescale=8, control=0x80):
        await self.write(0, prescale & 255)
        await self.write(1, (prescale >> 8) & 255)
        await self.write(2, control)
        await self.tick(20)

    def trace_begin(self):
        self.events = []
        self.prev_scl = int(self.dut.scl.value)
        self.prev_sda = int(self.dut.sda.value)
        self.tracing = True

    def trace_bits(self, start):
        events = self.events
        if start:
            indices = [i for i in range(len(events)) if events[i][0] == "start"]
            assert indices, "START was not observed on the bus"
            events = events[indices[-1] + 1:]
        return [value for kind, value in events if kind == "bit"]

    async def clear_interrupt(self):
        await self.write(4, 1)
        await self.tick(4)
        status = await self.read(4)
        assert (status & 1) == 0, "IACK did not clear IF"

    async def command(self, command, transmitted=None, received=None,
                      ack=None, check_bus=True):
        await self.clear_interrupt()
        if transmitted is not None:
            await self.write(3, transmitted)
        self.trace_begin()
        await self.write(4, command)

        status = 0
        for unused in range(400):
            await self.tick(8)
            status = await self.read(4)
            if status & 1:
                break
        else:
            assert False, "I2C command did not complete"

        await self.tick(12)
        status = await self.read(4)
        self.tracing = False
        assert status & 1
        assert (status & 0x3e) == 0, "AL, TIP, or reserved status bits set"
        if ack is not None:
            assert ((status >> 7) & 1) == ack, "wrong received acknowledge"

        if check_bus and (transmitted is not None or received is not None):
            bits = self.trace_bits(bool(command & 0x80))
            assert len(bits) >= 9, "too few SCL rising edges"
            byte = transmitted if transmitted is not None else received
            expected = [(byte >> bit) & 1 for bit in range(7, -1, -1)]
            if transmitted is not None:
                expected.append(ack)
            else:
                expected.append(1 if command & 8 else 0)
            assert bits[:9] == expected, "wrong I2C byte or acknowledge on bus"

        if command & 0x40:
            assert any(kind == "stop" for kind, value in self.events), \
                "STOP was not observed on the bus"

            elif old_scl and scl and not old_sda and sda:

    dut.wb_stb_i.value = 0
    return value


async def configure(dut, prescale=8, control=0x80):
    await wb_write(dut, 0, prescale & 0xff)
    await wb_write(dut, 1, (prescale >> 8) & 0xff)
    await wb_write(dut, 2, control)
    await ClockCycles(dut.clk, 20)


async def wait_complete(dut):
    for unused in range(1000):
        status = await wb_read(dut, 4)
        assert status & 0x1c == 0
        if status & 1:
            return status
    assert False, "command did not complete"


async def command(dut, bits):
    # IACK clears the previous completion while starting the new command.
    await wb_write(dut, 4, bits | 1)
    return await wait_complete(dut)


async def send_byte(dut, value, start_bit=False, stop_bit=False, ack=True):
    await wb_write(dut, 3, value)
    bits = 0x10
    if start_bit:
        bits |= 0x80
    if stop_bit:
        bits |= 0x40
    status = await command(dut, bits)
    assert status & 0x20 == 0, "unexpected arbitration loss"
    assert bool(status & 0x80) == (not ack), "wrong target acknowledge"
    return status


async def receive_byte(dut, last=False):
    bits = 0x20
    if last:
        bits |= 0x48
    status = await command(dut, bits)
    assert status & 0x20 == 0, "unexpected arbitration loss"
    return await wb_read(dut, 3)

    await send_byte(dut, pointer)

    await set_pointer(dut, pointer)
    await send_byte(dut, 0xa1, start_bit=True)
    result = []
    for index in range(count):
        result.append(await receive_byte(dut, last=index == count - 1))
    return result


async def trace_bus(dut, running, segments, stops):
    await Timer(1, unit="ns")
    old_scl = int(dut.scl.value)
    old_sda = int(dut.sda.value)
    while running[0]:
        await RisingEdge(dut.clk)
        await Timer(1, unit="ns")
        scl = int(dut.scl.value)
        sda = int(dut.sda.value)
        if scl and old_scl and old_sda and not sda:
            segments.append([])
        elif scl and old_scl and not old_sda and sda:
            stops.append(1)
        if scl and not old_scl and segments:
            segments[-1].append(sda)
        old_scl = scl
        old_sda = sda

    dut.wb_adr_i.value = addr
    dut.wb_we_i.value = 0
    dut.wb_cyc_i.value = 1
    dut.wb_stb_i.value = 1

    await RisingEdge(dut.clk)
    await Timer(1, unit="ns")
    assert int(dut.wb_ack_o.value) == 1
    value = int(dut.wb_dat_o.value)

    await FallingEdge(dut.clk)
    dut.wb_cyc_i.value = 0
    dut.wb_stb_i.value = 0
    await cycles(dut, 1)
    return value


async def configure(dut, prescale=7, control=0xC0):
    await wb_write(dut, 0, prescale & 0xFF)
    await wb_write(dut, 1, (prescale >> 8) & 0xFF)
    await wb_write(dut, 2, control)
    await cycles(dut, 12)


async def clear_interrupt(dut):
    await wb_write(dut, 4, 0x01)
    await cycles(dut, 3)
    status = await wb_read(dut, 4)
    assert (status & 0x01) == 0


async def wait_interrupt(dut):
    for unused in range(800):
        status = await wb_read(dut, 4)
        assert (status & 0x1C) == 0
        if status & 1:
            return status
    assert False, "I2C command did not complete"


async def command(dut, value, tx=None, expect_ack=None):
    await clear_interrupt(dut)
    if tx is not None:
        await wb_write(dut, 3, tx)
    await wb_write(dut, 4, value)
    status = await wait_interrupt(dut)
    assert (status & 0x20) == 0, "unexpected arbitration loss"
    assert (status & 0x02) == 0, "TIP remained set after completion"
    if expect_ack is not None:
        assert ((status >> 7) & 1) == expect_ack
    return status


async def observe_bus(dut, events):
    old_scl = int(dut.scl.value)
    old_sda = int(dut.sda.value)
    while True:
        await RisingEdge(dut.clk)
        await Timer(1, unit="ns")
        scl = int(dut.scl.value)
        sda = int(dut.sda.value)
        if old_scl and scl and old_sda and not sda:
            events.append(("start", 0))
        elif old_scl and scl and not old_sda and sda:
            events.append(("stop", 0))
        if not old_scl and scl:
            events.append(("bit", sda))
        old_scl = scl
        old_sda = sda


def byte_bits(value, ack):
    return [((value >> bit) & 1) for bit in range(7, -1, -1)] + [ack]


def bus_segments(events):
    segments = []
    current = None
    stops = 0
    for kind, value in events:
        if kind == "start":
            current = []
            segments.append(current)
        elif kind == "stop":
            stops += 1
            current = None
        elif kind == "bit" and current is not None:
            current.append(value)
    return segments, stops

    await command(dut, 0x10, pointer, 0)


async def read_at_pointer(dut, pointer, count):
    await set_pointer(dut, pointer)
    await command(dut, 0x90, 0xA1, 0)
    values = []
    for index in range(count):
        last = index == count - 1
        await command(dut, 0x68 if last else 0x20)
        values.append(await wb_read(dut, 3))
    await cycles(dut, 30)
    return values

    assert int(dut.wb_inta_o.value) == 0


@cocotb.test()
async def target_burst_and_bus_bits(dut):
    await start(dut)
    await configure(dut)
    events = []
    watcher = cocotb.start_soon(observe_bus(dut, events))

    values = [0x96, 0x00, 0xFF, 0x3C]
    await command(dut, 0x90, 0xA0, 0)
    assert (await wb_read(dut, 4)) & 0x40
    await command(dut, 0x10, 0xFE, 0)
    for value in values:
        await command(dut, 0x10, value, 0)

    await command(dut, 0x90, 0xA1, 0)
    received = []
    for index in range(len(values)):
        await command(dut, 0x68 if index == len(values) - 1 else 0x20)
        received.append(await wb_read(dut, 3))
    assert received == values
    await cycles(dut, 50)
    assert (await wb_read(dut, 4) & 0x40) == 0
    assert int(dut.scl.value) == 1
    assert int(dut.sda.value) == 1

    watcher.cancel()
    segments, stops = bus_segments(events)
    assert len(segments) == 2
    assert stops == 1
    first = []
    for value in [0xA0, 0xFE] + values:
        first += byte_bits(value, 0)
    second = byte_bits(0xA1, 0)
    for index, value in enumerate(values):
        second += byte_bits(value, 1 if index == len(values) - 1 else 0)
    assert segments[0][:len(first)] == first
    assert segments[1][:len(second)] == second

    # A nonmatching address must be NACKed and must not modify memory.
    await command(dut, 0xD0, 0xA2, 1)
    await cycles(dut, 40)
    assert await read_at_pointer(dut, 2, 4) == values


@cocotb.test()
async def interrupts_and_external_bus_state(dut):
    await start(dut)
    await configure(dut, 7, 0x80)

    # External open-drain START and STOP are detected after filtering.
    dut.ext_sda_low.value = 1
    await cycles(dut, 60)
    assert int(dut.sda.value) == 0
    assert (await wb_read(dut, 4) & 0x40) != 0
    dut.ext_sda_low.value = 0
    await cycles(dut, 60)
    assert int(dut.sda.value) == 1
    assert (await wb_read(dut, 4) & 0x40) == 0
    dut.ext_scl_low.value = 1
    await cycles(dut, 10)
    assert int(dut.scl.value) == 0
    dut.ext_scl_low.value = 0
    await cycles(dut, 30)
    assert int(dut.scl.value) == 1

    # IF is set even with interrupt output disabled.
    await command(dut, 0xD0, 0xA2, 1)
    await cycles(dut, 5)
    assert int(dut.wb_inta_o.value) == 0
    assert (await wb_read(dut, 4) & 1) == 1
    await wb_write(dut, 2, 0xC0)
    await cycles(dut, 4)
    assert int(dut.wb_inta_o.value) == 1
    await wb_write(dut, 2, 0x80)
    await cycles(dut, 4)
    assert int(dut.wb_inta_o.value) == 0
    assert (await wb_read(dut, 4) & 1) == 1
    await wb_write(dut, 2, 0xC0)
    await cycles(dut, 4)
    assert int(dut.wb_inta_o.value) == 1
    await clear_interrupt(dut)
    await cycles(dut, 4)
    assert int(dut.wb_inta_o.value) == 0


@cocotb.test()
async def arbitration_loss_and_recovery(dut):
    await start(dut)
    await configure(dut)
    await clear_interrupt(dut)
    await wb_write(dut, 3, 0xA0)
    await wb_write(dut, 4, 0x90)

    # Wait until the first transmitted 1 is presented with SCL low.
    found = False
    for unused in range(500):
        await cycles(dut, 1)
        if int(dut.scl.value) == 0 and int(dut.sda.value) == 1:
            found = True
            break
    assert found
    dut.ext_sda_low.value = 1
    status = await wait_interrupt(dut)
    await cycles(dut, 10)
    status = await wb_read(dut, 4)
    assert status & 0x20
    assert status & 0x01
    assert int(dut.wb_inta_o.value) == 1

    # Release the external device, producing a STOP once SCL is released.
    dut.ext_sda_low.value = 0
    await cycles(dut, 80)
    await clear_interrupt(dut)
    assert (await wb_read(dut, 4) & 0x20) != 0

    # A fresh START clears sticky AL and permits normal operation.
    status = await command(dut, 0xD0, 0xA0, 0)
    assert (status & 0x20) == 0
    await cycles(dut, 40)
    assert int(dut.scl.value) == 1
    assert int(dut.sda.value) == 1


@cocotb.test()
async def clock_stretch_and_target_reset_scope(dut):
    await start(dut)
    await configure(dut)
    dut.stretch_en.value = 1

    # Hold SCL low externally during a write bit. The transfer must wait.
    await clear_interrupt(dut)
    await wb_write(dut, 3, 0xA0)
    await wb_write(dut, 4, 0x90)
    found = False
    for unused in range(500):
        await cycles(dut, 1)
        if int(dut.scl.value) == 0 and int(dut.sda.value) == 1:
            found = True
            break
    assert found
    dut.ext_scl_low.value = 1
    await cycles(dut, 180)
    assert int(dut.scl.value) == 0
    status = await wb_read(dut, 4)
    assert status & 0x02
    assert (status & 0x01) == 0
    dut.ext_scl_low.value = 0
    status = await wait_interrupt(dut)
    assert (status & 0xA2) == 0

    # Continue with target stretching enabled, including pointer wrap.
    await command(dut, 0x10, 3, 0)
    await command(dut, 0x10, 0x5A, 0)
    await command(dut, 0x50, 0xC3, 0)
    await cycles(dut, 50)
    assert await read_at_pointer(dut, 3, 2) == [0x5A, 0xC3]

    # Synchronous reset affects the master, not target memory.
    await FallingEdge(dut.clk)
    dut.wb_rst_i.value = 1
    await cycles(dut, 2)
    await FallingEdge(dut.clk)
    dut.wb_rst_i.value = 0
    await cycles(dut, 5)
    assert await wb_read(dut, 0) == 0xFF
    assert await wb_read(dut, 1) == 0xFF
    assert await wb_read(dut, 2) == 0
    assert await wb_read(dut, 5) == 0
    assert await wb_read(dut, 6) == 0
    await configure(dut)
    assert await read_at_pointer(dut, 3, 2) == [0x5A, 0xC3]

    # Asynchronous reset also clears target memory and releases both lines.
    await FallingEdge(dut.clk)
    dut.rst_n.value = 0
    await Timer(1, unit="ns")
    assert int(dut.scl.value) == 1
    assert int(dut.sda.value) == 1
    assert int(dut.wb_inta_o.value) == 0
    await cycles(dut, 3)
    await FallingEdge(dut.clk)
    dut.rst_n.value = 1
    await cycles(dut, 5)
    await configure(dut)
    assert await read_at_pointer(dut, 3, 2) == [0, 0]
